title: Applied Reasoning & Capstone
description: Study planning under uncertainty, causal claims and alternative explanations, reasoning with retrieved evidence, and capstone: a verified problem-solving harness. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Planning under uncertainty
lessons.description: Add a verification step and an alternate route condition.
lessons.conceptOverview: Plans should distinguish known state from uncertain observations and include contingency checks. Acting as if uncertain assumptions are facts can make an otherwise coherent plan fail.
lessons.whyItMatters: Uncertain premises need checks or contingencies.

sections.content: Add a verification step and an alternate route condition. Write down your reasoning and check it against the concept before continuing.

commonMistakes: A logically consistent plan is safe even with unsupported premises.

lessons.title: Causal claims and alternative explanations
lessons.description: Design a comparison that isolates the model change.
lessons.conceptOverview: Correlation or temporal order alone does not establish causation. Consider confounders, selection effects and alternative mechanisms before attributing an outcome to an intervention.
lessons.whyItMatters: Causal attribution requires controlling plausible alternatives.

lessons.title: Reasoning with retrieved evidence
lessons.description: Identify the definition mismatch before comparing trends.
lessons.conceptOverview: Combine retrieved claims only when their scope, dates and definitions align. Missing evidence should remain missing rather than being filled with a plausible connecting story.
lessons.whyItMatters: Evidence synthesis requires compatible definitions and scope.

lessons.title: Capstone: a verified problem-solving harness
lessons.description: Deliver task definitions, validators, run manifests and an error analysis.
lessons.conceptOverview: Build a static task set with arithmetic, scheduling and code checks, fixed tool responses and bounded candidate attempts. Report correctness, verifier errors and resource use separately.
